50 Ω 与 75 Ω 混用：驻波偏高、损耗变大；接收尚可，发射前务必核对阻抗。: Mixing 50 Ω and 75 Ω: SWR runs high and loss increases; fine for reception, but always verify the impedance before transmitting.
75 Ω 视频同轴，RG-6 多为铝箔加编织双层屏蔽: 75 Ω video coax; RG-6 usually has a foil plus braided double shield
BNC 的螺纹版本，抗振动、防水较好；车载与室外设备上常见。: The threaded version of the BNC, better at resisting vibration and moisture; common on mobile and outdoor equipment.
HF 电台最常用的螺纹接头：PL-259 是插头、SO-239 是插座。“UHF: The most common threaded connector on HF rigs: the PL-259 is the plug and the SO-239 the socket. “UHF connector” is only a historical name — it is not constant-impedance by design and, while usable at VHF, becomes clearly lossy and discontinuous above UHF.
做 1/4 波长匹配线或相位线时要用线缆内波长（自由空间波长 × 速度因子，约: For quarter-wave matching or phasing lines, use the wavelength inside the cable (free-space wavelength × velocity factor, about 0.66–0.91).
卡口快速插拔，测试仪器、手台与 SDR 常用；50 Ω 与 75 Ω 两种外形不: Bayonet quick connect/disconnect, common on test instruments, handhelds and SDRs; the 50 Ω and 75 Ω versions have different shapes and must not be mated.
卡扣式小型接头，多用于设备内部与机柜跳线；不适合室外与大功率。: Small snap-on connector, mostly used inside equipment and for rack patch leads; unsuitable for outdoor use and high power.
受潮进水：介质损耗变大、导体氧化甚至断路，驻波缓慢变差 —— 室外接头防水是第一: Water ingress: dielectric loss rises, conductors oxidise or even break, and SWR slowly worsens — weatherproofing outdoor connectors is the first priority.
只传音频与视频，阻抗与屏蔽都不适合射频，不能拿来做天线接头。: Carries only audio and video; both its impedance and shielding are unsuitable for RF, so never use it as an antenna connector.
大功率基站用接头，防水与互调指标最好；体积大、价格高，业余台少见。: High-power base-station connector with the best weatherproofing and intermodulation performance; bulky and expensive, rarely seen at amateur stations.
实心聚乙烯介质、单层编织屏蔽，外径约 10 mm，较硬: Solid polyethylene dielectric, single braided shield, about 10 mm outside diameter, rather stiff
实心聚乙烯介质、单层编织屏蔽，外径约 5 mm，柔性好: Solid polyethylene dielectric, single braided shield, about 5 mm outside diameter, very flexible
室外接头必须防水：自融胶带半重叠绕包 + 热缩管，接头朝下或做滴水环，防止水从接: Outdoor connectors must be weatherproofed: half-lapped self-amalgamating tape plus heat-shrink, with the connector facing down or a drip loop to keep water out of the mating face.
小型螺纹接头，手台、SDR 与跳线常用；插拔寿命只有数百次，别频繁插拔。: Small threaded connector, common on handhelds, SDRs and patch leads; rated for only a few hundred mating cycles, so avoid connecting and disconnecting it frequently.
尽量少转接：每加一个转接头就多一处损耗与失配；固定安装直接换成对应接头。: Minimise adapters: every adapter adds another point of loss and mismatch; in permanent installations, fit the right connector instead.
屏蔽层尽量 360° 环接：用压接箍或夹箍整圈压紧，不要留「猪尾」细线接地 ——: Bond the shield as close to 360° as possible: crimp or clamp it fully around instead of leaving a thin “pigtail” to ground — the higher the frequency, the greater the inductance of that thin wire and the more the shield is defeated.
屏蔽破损或编织氧化：驻波突变，还可能干扰电视与音响（RFI）；重点查接头根部与弯: Damaged shield or oxidised braid: SWR jumps and TV or audio interference (RFI) may follow; check the base of the connector and any bends first.
平衡馈线，介质以空气为主，损耗极低: Balanced feedline with mostly air dielectric and extremely low loss
弯曲半径不小于约 5 倍电缆外径，别在接头根部反复弯折；走线用扎带固定，避免自重: Keep the bending radius at least about 5 times the cable's outside diameter and never flex a cable repeatedly at the base of a connector; secure the run with cable ties so its own weight does not pull on the connector.
按位置选：室外与馈线入口用 N 型并做防水；手台、SDR 用 SMA；测试台用: Choose by location: Type N with weatherproofing outdoors and at feedline entries; SMA on handhelds and SDRs; BNC on the test bench.
按功率与尺寸选：大功率、粗电缆用 N 型或 7/16 DIN；SMA、SMB 只: Choose by power and size: Type N or 7/16 DIN for high power and thick cable; SMA and SMB only for low-power equipment ports.
按频率选：HF 用 PL-259 或 N 型；VHF/UHF 用 N、BNC 或: Choose by frequency: PL-259 or Type N on HF; N, BNC or SMA at VHF/UHF — the higher the frequency, the more you need a constant-impedance, well-shielded connector.
损耗中等、较柔软；20 m 以内的 HF 馈线常用。: Moderate loss and fairly flexible; a common HF feedline up to 20 m.
损耗低、屏蔽好；VHF/UHF 与较长 HF 馈线，注意弯曲半径。: Low loss and good shielding; VHF/UHF and longer HF feedlines, but mind the bending radius.
损耗偏高；跳线、便携与 10 m 以内的短馈线。: Fairly high loss; patch leads, portable setups and short feedlines up to 10 m.
损耗最高；只用于设备内部与极短跳线。: The highest loss; only for inside equipment and very short patch leads.
损耗较低；固定架设的中长距离 HF 馈线。: Fairly low loss; permanently installed medium-to-long HF feedlines.
排查顺序：先看外观（氧化、进水、松动），再用万用表测通断与短路，最后用驻波表或天: Troubleshooting order: first inspect visually (oxidation, water, looseness), then check continuity and shorts with a multimeter, and finally locate the fault section by section with an SWR meter or antenna analyser.
接头松动、中心针缩回：接触电阻与打火，发射时驻波忽高忽低；重新拧紧或重做接头。: Loose connector or recessed centre pin: contact resistance and arcing, with SWR swinging up and down while transmitting; tighten or remake the connector.
接收与卫星中频用；不能与 50 Ω 发射系统混用。: For reception and satellite IF; must not be mixed into a 50 Ω transmit system.
极细同轴，外径约 2.5 mm，柔性最好: Very thin coax, about 2.5 mm outside diameter, the most flexible of all
泡沫介质、铝箔加编织双层屏蔽，外径约 10 mm: Foam dielectric, foil plus braided double shield, about 10 mm outside diameter
泡沫聚乙烯介质、单层编织屏蔽，外径约 6 mm: Foam polyethylene dielectric, single braided shield, about 6 mm outside diameter
焊接要焊透焊牢、焊锡不外溢，别把芯线与屏蔽烫通；压接要用对应压接钳，避免虚接。: Solder thoroughly and firmly without letting solder overflow, and never bridge the centre conductor to the shield; use the matching crimp tool to avoid a poor joint.
电视与卫星接收的螺纹接头（有线电视、机顶盒）；不能用在 50 Ω 发射系统上。: The threaded connector used for TV and satellite reception (cable TV, set-top boxes); it must not be used in a 50 Ω transmit system.
螺纹连接、可防水、损耗小、功率容量大；室外馈线入口与 UHF 以上的首选，按恒阻: Threaded, weatherproof, low loss and high power handling; the first choice for outdoor feedline entries and for UHF and above, designed as a constant-impedance connector.
装完用万用表确认中心针与屏蔽不短路、芯线导通；上机前用驻波表或天线分析仪复测。: After assembly, use a multimeter to confirm that the centre pin is not shorted to the shield and that the centre conductor is continuous; check again with an SWR meter or antenna analyser before transmitting.
配巴伦接平衡天线与天调；怕碰触与雨水，需架空固定。: Use a balun to feed balanced antennas and tuners; it dislikes contact and rain, so support it clear of the ground.
阻抗一致：50 Ω 系统不要用 75 Ω 接头（F 型、75 Ω 的 BNC），: Keep the impedance consistent: never use 75 Ω connectors (Type F, 75 Ω BNC) in a 50 Ω system, or the connector itself becomes a mismatch point.
